about: Fixed vectors of the WebAuthn verification of the remote wire (fio-spec 7.4, step 2.4). The w3c block is copied from the standard and never regenerated; the house block is produced by the software authenticator of test/unit/remote.webauthn.test.ts with REMOTE_VECTORS_UPDATE=1.

w3c.source: W3C Web Authentication Level 3, section 16 (Test Vectors): https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-3/#sctn-test-vectors
